description: This file defines and manages parsing, formatting, and locale-specific handling for days of the week within the Moment.js library, including regex tokens, parsing tokens, and locale data functions.

methods.name: localeWeekdays
methods.description: Returns the list of weekdays for the current locale, formatted according to the provided format.

methods.name: localeWeekdaysShort
methods.description: Returns the list of short weekday names for the current locale.

methods.name: localeWeekdaysMin
methods.description: Returns the list of minimal weekday names for the current locale.

methods.name: handleStrictParse
methods.description: Handles strict parsing of weekday names based on locale and format.

methods.name: localeWeekdaysParse
methods.description: Parses a weekday name string into an index based on locale and strictness.

methods.name: getSetDayOfWeek
methods.description: Gets or sets the day of the week (0-6).

methods.name: getSetLocaleDayOfWeek
methods.description: Gets or sets the locale-specific day of the week.

methods.name: getSetISODayOfWeek
methods.description: Gets or sets the ISO day of the week (1-7).

methods.name: weekdaysRegex
methods.description: Returns the regex for matching weekday names, strict or lenient.

methods.name: weekdaysShortRegex
methods.description: Returns the regex for matching short weekday names, strict or lenient.

methods.name: weekdaysMinRegex
methods.description: Returns the regex for matching minimal weekday names, strict or lenient.

methods.name: computeWeekdaysParse
methods.description: Computes regex patterns for parsing weekday names in various formats.
